name: Meteoric-Erg
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past crystal cavern networks, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
For traders, exotic matter alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
